units: <cite ref="Shabbat 55b:9">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>פ̇ח̇ז̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:4">Gen. XLIX, 4</cite>) <he>פִּ֗ילַּלְתָּה ח̇לתה ז̇רחה וכ׳</he> thou didst plead, thou didst pray, thy prayer rose &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:1">Ib.</cite> <he>היו שוהים … ומִתְפַּלְּלִים</he> used to tarry a while (in meditation) and then say the prayers. Ib. IV, 3 <he>יִתְפַּלֵּל שמונה עשרה</he> should pray the eighteen benedictions. Ib. 4 <he>מִתְפַּלֵּל תפלה קצרה</he> says a short prayer. Y. ib. 8ᵇ top <he>ספק נתפ׳ ספק לא נ׳</he> if he is in doubt whether he has or has not said his prayers; a. v. fr.
